Name: BinsNotCountedTable
Expression:
VAR CurrentYear = YEAR(TODAY())
RETURN
FILTER(
    'jdis_Phy_Inv',
    NOT (
        CALCULATE(
            COUNTROWS('jdis_Phy_Inv'),
            YEAR('jdis_Phy_Inv'[Stocktake Date]) = CurrentYear
        ) > 0
    )
)
